name: collection iterator outlives receiver across arena resets
source:
function make():any { const m=new Map<string,number>(); m.set("kept",42); const a:any=m; return a.entries(); }
async function main():Promise<void> { const it:any=make(); for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ await new Promise<void>((resolve)=>setTimeout(resolve,1)); } console.log(JSON.stringify(it.next().value),it.next().done); }
